findings.summary: Same-list repository admission is enforced only when add_repo has already been encountered. For a list ordered dispatch(repo R), add_repo(repo R), repo_admission has no entry at the dispatch, so the external dispatch executes before admission, even if the later add_repo fails. P1 requires same-list add_repo to succeed before its dependent dispatch. Identify same-list admission dependencies before executing effects and refuse a dependent dispatch until admission has succeeded; add an offline regression covering reversed ordering and failed admission.

The done guard considers only the current call's results, not outstanding required deliveries for the goal. With two queued messages, A can request a reply that returns UNKNOWN and B can return an empty done list; turn drains both and returns B's done verdict despite A's unresolved reply. goal_line converts that verdict into a done terminal. This violates P4's requirement that done remain pending until all required delivery receipts exist. Preserve and consult outstanding delivery obligations across calls and reconstruction, and add an offline two-request regression.
